action: subtract successive bands from the selected base-volume face to form a grade
divergence: Measured on a bare extruded body, uncut by the envelope: massv2 grade removes 576 m3 (subtract) acting on 1 volume(s) (single). The BOOK records this word as subtract on single volumes. The two agree on both counts, so the second implementation is a restatement rather than a different word - it may still differ in proportion, which this bench does not measure.

mathematical_basis.reference: A staircase of regularized Boolean differences; the terraced section a setback regulation produces
mathematical_basis.definition: A monotone staircase cut into one face: each step is a half-space difference, so the whole is strictly subtractive on a single volume.
mathematical_basis.shipped_as: no standard modifier; modelled as repeated Boolean cuts

delivery_contract.why: A unary AST chain, a decompose() != 1 refusal inside every macro, and a maximum_components=1 promotion gate. The reason is written in candidate_analysis.py: a detached piece is no more architectural than a small Lego speck, and split wings or arrays must be joined by an explicit bridge or spine.
delivery_contract.note: So the BOOK record's `multiple` means how many volumes the operative involves, NOT how many bodies come back.
